mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_history (user_id, recipe_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recipeId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.title AS title, r.description AS description, r.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, r.prep_time AS prepTime, r.cook_time AS cookTime, r.total_time AS totalTime, r.difficulty AS difficulty, r.servings AS servings, r.category AS category, r.tags AS tags, r.author_id AS authorId, r.is_public AS isPublic, r.likes_count AS likesCount, r.calories AS calories, r.protein AS protein, r.fat AS fat, r.carbs AS carbs, r.tips AS tips, r.flavor_profile AS flavorProfile, r.status AS status, r.reject_reason AS rejectReason, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, h.viewed_at AS viewedAt FROM recipe_history h JOIN recipe r ON r.id = h.recipe_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY h.viewed_at DESC
